name: Dipsadipsa
body:
Dipsa
CR 1

You feel the heat emanating from this dull-colored reptile’s body even before seeing it. Its jaws snap nervously, searching for flesh to bite.

XP 400
N Small animal (aquatic)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 size)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +4 (1d4-2 plus poison)
Special Attacks dehydration

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 3
Base Atk +1; CMB +0; CMD 10 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Improved InitiativeB, Weapon Finesse
Skills Perception +9 Stealth +14, Swim +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth
SQ amphibious

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dehydration (Ex)

A creature that fails its save against the dipsa’s venom takes 1d6 points of nonlethal damage per round until the venom’s effect ends. After that, the creature is considered to be suffering from dehydration and must make Constitution checks accordingly.

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 13; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str damage + dehydration; cure 2 consecutive saves.

Familiar

The master of a dipsa familiar gains a +4 bonus on Constitution checks to avoid dehydration.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm deserts/oasis
Organization solitary, pair, or nest (1-6)
Treasure none

Dipsae live in the few humid patches they can find in deserts, sucking all humidity from their prey in order to survive.
